hero_lead: Meridian provides strategic tax advisory, transfer pricing documentation, and dispute defense for corporations in Indonesia. Led directly by licensed senior partners.
stat_p1_desc: Annual return filing, monthly compliance, and diagnostic reviews.
stat_p2_desc: Local File, Master File, and CbCR aligned with PMK-172/2023.
stat_p3_desc: SP2DK response, tax audits, Objections, and Tax Court litigation.
stat_p4_desc: M&A tax due diligence, treaty structuring, and PE risk reviews.
practice_section_subtitle: A structured approach to maintain compliance and defend corporate tax positions under regulatory scrutiny.
pillar1_summary: Comprehensive management of corporate income tax, withholding taxes, and VAT to ensure timely compliance and prevent audit exposures.
pillar2_summary: Preparation of defensible Local File, Master File, and CbCR backed by rigorous financial benchmarking aligned with PMK-172/2023 and OECD standards.
pillar3_summary: Technical and legal representation for formal SP2DK explanations, tax audit closing conferences (PAHP), Objections, and Tax Court appeals.
pillar4_summary: Buy-side and sell-side tax due diligence, tax treaty optimization (P3B/Form DGT), and permanent establishment risk mitigation for cross-border investments.
diff_section_subtitle: We prioritize quality of advice, analytical precision, and senior partner accountability across every engagement.
diff1_desc: Every matter is directed by licensed tax court attorneys and registered consultants with decades of combined experience.
diff2_desc: Deep practical track record in tax audits, formal objection reviews, and Tax Court jurisprudence.
diff3_desc: Data analyses and workpapers prepared to exacting standards, built to withstand formal regulatory scrutiny.
